title: History and how it is told
description: Tell the same event two ways, and say why they differ.

explanation.summary: History in Spanish is not one story but a set of accounts, and the words for those accounts are the point of this unit. la fuente is where a claim comes from, la memoria is what is kept of it, and la perspectiva decides what is inside the frame and what is left out of it.

sections.heading: Where the account comes from
sections.body: una fuente is anything you can check: un archivo, un documento, un testimonio. la crónica is the written telling of a period, and una época is the period itself; la historia se mide en siglos. Cuando dos fuentes no coinciden, el asunto no se resuelve: se explica. Lo que se conserva de todo eso es la memoria, y lo que se transmite a las siguientes generaciones es la herencia.

examples.es: El archivo conserva cartas de aquel siglo.
examples.en: The archive preserves letters from that century.

examples.es: El testimonio contradice la crónica oficial.
examples.en: The testimony contradicts the official chronicle.

examples.es: Cada época cuenta la historia desde su memoria.
examples.en: Each period tells the story from its own memory.

sections.heading: Two accounts of the same thing
sections.body: la perspectiva is the position from which a story is told, and no eyewitness has a neutral one. Un imperio looks different from inside the capital of the empire, and una conquista is a conquest for one side and a disaster for the other. The words of history do not hide this: la memoria de un pueblo and la memoria de otro rarely say the same thing.

examples.es: Un imperio no se ve igual desde dentro.
examples.en: An empire is not seen the same way from the inside.

examples.es: Para unos fue una conquista y para otros una catástrofe.
examples.en: For some it was a conquest and for others a catastrophe.

examples.es: La herencia de aquel tiempo sigue viva.
examples.en: The legacy of that time is still alive.

exercises.note: A source is a noun (la fuente) and a telling is another noun (la crónica): the same past, described from different places.
